## Earlier upstream evidence retained by reference

### Frozen HFT

The pinned source records the dual-XGMII pre-hardware system, protocol/session/replay closure and simulation-derived latency baseline. Its claims remain upstream claims at the pinned SHA; this integration repo does not rewrite their evidence level.

### Frozen RMIC

The pinned source records M5.4 functional regressions and U50 post-route closure for the standalone dual-flow risk core. Those results establish feasibility of the frozen core, not timing closure of the combined futures integration.

## Integration history notes

- The 2023 bidirectional-risk thesis was re-audited before integration. RMIC already addresses the thesis future work for hardware compensation and conflict-free multi-account throughput, while rate/outstanding/volatility/stop-loss controls remain integration-layer gaps.
- Frozen RMIC accounting is stock-like/long-only. TAIFEX futures integration therefore introduced separate long/short and OPEN/CLOSE semantics instead of silently interpreting SELL as inventory liquidation.
- The frozen HFT R01 packer stores 16-bit quantity, matching the TMP R01 `uint16` quantity contract; adapter zero-extension is explicit.
- Frozen HFT report sequence ownership remains authoritative for R02/R32 commit/de-dup/gap handling. Integration accounting never mutates from raw R02/R32 decoder events.
- I2 state ownership is fail-closed after reset: configured ownership is invalidated even though BRAM contents physically remain, so explicit recovery/configuration is required.
- The futures order-context payload fits within the measured frozen 96-bit AMU value while carrying account, product, Side, PositionEffect, OrdType, TIF, limit price and remaining quantity.
- R02/R32 reconciliation uses authoritative `before_qty`, `LastQty` and `LeavesQty` relationships. Mismatched old/duplicate events cannot mutate account state even if they are erroneously presented to the committed bridge.
- R03 release is context-driven and delete-once: after the first accepted reject releases the outstanding reservation and removes context, a repeated R03 is a context miss and cannot release twice.
- GitHub CI intentionally uses an AMU contract stub because the RMIC upstream is private. Hash/collision/XPM evidence is not inferred from this stub; the local I2 Vivado flow compiles the real pinned RMIC AMU.
